quotes.name: Maurice Franklin
quotes.quote: Lying here in the hospital, you hear things. Nurses talking, other patients' families visiting. Chinatown's been hit hard this season - seems like every other conversation is about someone else down there getting sick. quotes.name: Colin Soria
quotes.quote: You know, I don't live in Chinatown, but I've walked through enough to see how tight-knit that community is. When illness hits, you can feel it in the air—less chatter in the markets, fewer elders sitting out on the benches. But what gets me is how they rally. Neighbors checking in, dropping off meals without being asked. It's not about big gestures; it's the quiet way they carry each other. Reminds me of how my wife's family was when she got sick. Sometimes just knowing someone's there makes the weight a little lighter.
